test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FRIDAY’ is written as ‘KTHACF’ and ‘MOSTLY’ is written as ‘UQOANV’. How will ‘GINGER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

The code for the word FRIDAY is written as 'KTHACF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff7d755a1d692d39f6b4af7d435768b0c5ae52f43c58b20e7e411aecd233a4cc.png] 

In the same way MOSTLY is written as 'UQOANV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ae17b2c4ee3ab7e63a7d29587155113e9f7821663cd8b2509797151adc159ff.png] 

Similarly,

The word GINGER will be written as 'PKITGI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25dbe0cefea0ac087f04f5bca953fede0409a92015956f555c9f46a64d5c91e0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3)**.
